messages:
incident-bot: [INCIDENT CLOSED] P1 INC-2026 — API tail latency spike resolved. Auto-generated PIR scheduling thread.
anya: We need a facilitator for the PIR. Impact: ~10% of requests 500s across EU + NA, mitigated by adding capacity and routing rules. Would like a 30-45m session. Who can run? Need someone to collect pre-read (timeline + top graphs) and get CS on the readout.
jordan: I can facilitate but I'm oncall Wed afternoon UTC. Could do Thurs morning instead.
sasha: I can run it Tue 14:00 UTC. Can someone shadow for notes and actions? @olivia? :hand: 
olivia: I can join as CS readout owner and cover customer impact. I can prepare the customer list and draft outreach.
mike: Happy to be shadow/follow-up owner for actions. I can pull grafana panels + queries and prepare a short data appendix.
anya: Prefer the facilitator to have incident context. @sasha — want a co-facilitator? Also need pre-read: timeline, top 3 hypotheses, steps taken, and a short mitigation checklist.
sasha: Yes, @mike as co-facilitator works for me. Proposed slots (react with :one:/:two:/:three: by EOD):
```
1) Tue 2026-05-12 14:00 UTC (preferred)
2) Wed 2026-05-13 09:00 UTC
3) Thu 2026-05-14 16:00 UTC
```
jordan: Reacting :one: but may have a partial overlap — I'll confirm ASAP.
olivia: :one: works for our affected customers in EU.
incident-bot: Reminder: attach the incident runbook & timeline: https://redwood.internal/incidents/INC-2026 and add the incident doc to the PIR.
sasha: Draft agenda: 1) timeline recap (5-7m) 2) data & reproduction attempts (10m) 3) RCA hypotheses + confirm next steps (15m) 4) customer readout + comms (5-8m) 5) actions & owners (remainder). Pre-read owners: @mike - data appendix, @olivia - customer impact summary, @anya - infra/changes. Please upload 24h before the session.
mike: I'll upload graphs + query samples by EOD today to the doc.
anya: I'll add infra change list and notes about autoscaler behavior and fallback policy.
olivia: I'll draft the customer-facing summary and a quick email template for CS to use.
sasha: OK confirmed — I'll schedule Tue 2026-05-12 14:00 UTC and send invites. I'll include a short pre-read checklist in the doc. Thanks everyone :thumbsup:
